text:
jordan: Originate RC for redwood-inference v2.13.0-rc2 -> candidate pinned at sha abc1234. Requesting promo window 2026-04-02 18:00-18:30 UTC. Release notes draft: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v2.13-rc2

deploybot: [deploybot] RC artifact uploaded: redwood-inference:v2.13.0-rc2 (sha: abc1234). CI: ✅ all checks passed. To schedule promotion run `/deploy promote rc v2.13.0-rc2 --window 2026-04-02T18:00Z` :robot_face:

qa-jen: Kicking off smoke on staging canary (10%) now — will post results in ~5m.

marie: Quick check — any DB migrations or long-running infra changes included?

jordan: No DB migrations, config-only changes: prefix cache TTL and batching tweak. Verified with @nate.

nate: Confirmed no schema changes. Recommend KV warm before promo; I'll schedule kv-warm at 18:45 UTC.

sherpa: Can we run a short perf smoke (50 rps for 5m) after kv-warm? want to validate p95 tail.

qa-jen: Smoke results attached: 200/200 OK, p50 48ms, p95 230ms, no elevated error traces. Logs -> https://logs.redwood/33579-smoke

ops-sheriff: Ack. Pin requested for candidate. I'll hold the slot and be on-call during the window. Please include explicit rollback steps in release notes. :shield:

jordan: Added rollback snippet to release notes:

```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy promote redwood-inference:stable --force --from-rc v2.13.0-rc2
```

marie: Docs PR with release notes + playbook: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/487 — includes rollback commands and signal checks.

deploybot: Promotion scheduled by @jordan for 2026-04-02T18:00Z. Plan: canary rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. Canary checks: smoke, error-rate delta, latency regressions. Auto-rollback threshold: >1% absolute increase in 5m error rate or >30% p95 latency increase. :white_check_mark:

ops-sheriff: I'll monitor traces and error budgets. If anything spikes, I'll hit abort and ping @sherpa + #eng-oncall.

jordan: All set from my side — final pin approved. Thanks team, will trigger the promote in the window. :tada:
